description.en: Returns one of the message IDs of a challenge NPC: kind 0, 1, 2 or 3 selects which (the challenge script passes its lose value). The challenge NPCs of a map (the characters that start a match when talked to) are kept in a table of the script system, by index; the challenge script ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut uses these commands.

The message ID, or 0 if the entry is empty or the kind is not 0 to 3.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: After a challenge match (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_enc.nut)
